cohort: 243 women who underwent elective or emergency Caesarean sections.
finding: The overall incidence of Surgical Site Infection was 14%, with obesity, prolonged operative time, and inadequate prophylactic antibiotic administration identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: The study found an overall incidence of Surgical Site Infection of 14% following Caesarean sections, identifying obesity, prolonged operative time, and inadequate prophylactic antibiotic administration as significant risk factors for this specific mode of birth.
